SUPERVISOR — USER VERDICT, Law 3 violation on the SCULPT lens. Marker: DEADSPACE-0606, ledger req_0032.

USER (with screenshot — read it): /home/siah/.claude/image-cache/c73c0a8c-84f9-4fad-b702-d4288adbf7bb/18.png — "the massive elephant in the room... the whole dead space under the mesh painter."

What it shows: the SCULPT lens's unwrap canvas occupies the top ~third of its column; sculpt verbs + brush sliders sit under it; below that, a giant BLACK VOID to the bottom of the page. That is WORKBENCH.md Law 3 verbatim: "No dead space. Column 4's content is the point of the page — it reads at full size... idle width gets spent on demonstrative dashboards, never left black."

Fix on the lens layout: the unwrap canvas EARNS THE COLUMN — aspect-preserving fill of the available height/width (it is the work surface; make it as big as the space allows), tools + sliders as a compact strip (top or side, whichever preserves the most canvas), zero black void. If after a true full-size fit there is still leftover space, Law 3's own answer applies: demonstrative use (e.g. the grid stats/sample strip), never blankness. Same data, layout only. Explicit paths, verify green, resolve req_0032. READY when the canvas reads at full size.
